body: The Negative, the Limitless, the Absolute are, logically speaking, absurd, since they are ideas which our reason cannot define.

body: This Head is the first Sephira, the Crown Kether, otherwise called Arikh Anpin, or Macroprosopus, the Vast Countenance.

body: Ten are the ineffable Sephiroth. Twenty-two are the Letters, the Foundation of all things; there are Three Mothers, Seven Double and Twelve Simple letters.

_provenance.note: The requested Mathers (1887) translation of Sepher Yetzirah could not be located as a freely accessible standalone scan; Mathers's own Sepher Yetzirah translation is often bound with or overshadowed by The Kabbalah Unveiled. Westcott's 1893 translation (also Golden-Dawn-adjacent, also PD) is used here instead. Flagged for follow-up if the Mathers edition surfaces.

body: He hath formed, weighed, and composed with these twenty-two letters every created thing, and the form of everything which shall hereafter be.

_provenance.note: Substitute for the requested Mathers translation; see mek-yetzirah-001 note.

body: The ineffable Sephiroth give forth the Ten numbers. First; the Spirit of the God of the living; Blessed and more than blessed be the Living God of ages.

body: The Foundation of all the other sounds and letters is provided by the Three Mothers, Aleph, Mem and Shin; they resemble a Balance, on the one hand the guilty, on the other hand the purified, and Aleph the Air is like the Tongue of a Balance standing between them.

_provenance.note: Substitute for the requested Mathers translation; see mek-yetzirah-001 note.
